summary: Iteration 7 tested backend + mobile-web frontend for live location rollout. Backend location/weather/mandi contract passed fully. Frontend denied-permission fallback, login, tab navigation, and profile saved-location display passed at 390x844. Forced-granted geolocation could not be reproduced in this automation environment (status stayed denied).

Weather and mandi correctly consume GPS-derived user context after location save (verified via persisted profile + downstream API responses).
frontend/app/_layout.tsx has LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true), which can hide runtime warnings during QA; consider narrowing ignored logs.

Profile shows live-location card plus non-empty pincode/address fields. rca_of_issue: Reproduction: login -> Home -> observe home-location-status shows denied fallback; tapping home-use-current-location keeps denied. Attempted mitigation: injected navigator.geolocation + permissions granted mocks via add_init_script and reloaded page, but status remained denied. Likely cause: Expo Location web permission flow is controlled by browser context permission state in this runner and not overridden by page-level mock; app itself previously passed granted path in main-agent run with granted geolocation context.
